opinions.text:
C. A. 2d Cir. Certiorari denied.
Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Douglas are of the opinion that certiorari should be granted and the judgment reversed for the reasons stated in their dissenting opinion in Linkletter v. Walker, ante, p. 640.

attorneys: Leon B. Polsky for petitioner. Louis J. Lefkowitz, Attorney General of New York, Samuel A. Hirshowitz, First Assistant Attorney General, Barry Ma-honey, Assistant Attorney General, and Brenda Soloff, Deputy Assistant Attorney General, for respondent.
